title: OpenAI API deprecations: self-serve fine-tuning
gist: OpenAI is closing self-serve fine-tuning in stages: to new organisations in May 2026, to inactive ones in July, and to everyone in January 2027. Tuned models keep serving only until their base model is retired.
changes: The largest counter-signal for the model lever. A frontier lab is withdrawing tuning, reportedly because prompting has become cheaper and faster, and every tune there dies with its base model.
caveats: This concerns tuning closed models, not open weights. The stated reason is second-hand, from a company that sells alternatives. Two cloud providers moved the other way and added reinforcement fine-tuning this year, without customer numbers. The date is that of the notice; the page itself is undated.

bears_on.note: A frontier lab is ending self-serve tuning, and tuned models retire with their base.
